list.title: Processes
list.subtitle: A chain of stages done by agents or agent teams. When a reviewer passes a stage the process continues; if it needs rework the agent redoes it using the feedback.

run.title: Run {{name}}
run.platform: Platform admins can't run a company's process.

list.empty: No processes yet. Copy one from Templates or create a new one.

delete.title: Delete process?
delete.body: Type “{{name}}” to delete. Running runs keep their snapshot.
delete.prompt: Type the process name to confirm

editor.name: Process name
editor.groups: Groups that can run (empty = whole company)
editor.budget: Token budget for the whole run (optional)

stage.name: Stage name

swap.family: Different node family — can't switch to this type.
swap.field_ref: Stage {{by}} still uses the field “{{field}}” of this stage.

stage.realLocked: Every stage in the previous step needs a reviewer
stage.adminModeReview: Hub is in admin-only mode: only admins who belong to the review group can approve (regular members have no inbox).
stage.adminModeAsk: Hub is in admin-only mode: AI questions at this stage cannot be answered (the chat inbox is frozen) — the run will wait.
stage.stepHint: Same step = runs in parallel (up to 3).
stage.backHint: The reviewer can choose to go back when marking Not passed. Up to 3 go-backs per run.
stage.backNone: The first step has nothing before it.

wait.title: Wait until date
wait.hint: Pauses the run at this stage until a set date, then continues on its own. No agent and no review step.
wait.fromNone: There is no date source yet. Add a Date input field, or declare a Date field in an earlier stage.
wait.offsetHint: Negative = before the base date, 0 = on the day, positive = after.
wait.tz: Uses the company time zone: {{tz}} ({{offset}}). The due time is fixed when the run reaches this stage; changing the company time zone later does not recalculate it.
wait.tzTemplate: Template: uses the time zone of the company that runs it (default {{tz}}).
wait.tzError: Couldn't load the company time zone.

formula.before_one: Due at {{time}}, {{count}} day before the date from {{source}}.
formula.before_other: Due at {{time}}, {{count}} days before the date from {{source}}.
formula.on: Due at {{time}}, on the date from {{source}}.
formula.after_one: Due at {{time}}, {{count}} day after the date from {{source}}.
formula.after_other: Due at {{time}}, {{count}} days after the date from {{source}}.

err.time: Enter a time as HH:mm, for example 09:00.
err.WAIT_INVALID: The date source isn't valid. Pick a Date input field or a Date field from a stage in an earlier step.

tool.title: Call tool
tool.hint: Calls one of the company's workflows with the starter's permissions, without an agent. The result is filtered by the fields you declare under Output.
tool.empty: No tool is enabled for your company yet — contact the platform admin
tool.template: Templates can't use “Call tool”. Copy the template to your company to pick a tool.
tool.sideEffectNote: This tool has real effects. The stage needs “Real action” on, and every stage in the previous step needs a reviewer.
tool.fileUnsupported: File parameters can't be used in processes yet, so this tool can't be picked.

err.argRequired: Choose a source for this parameter.
err.TOOL_INVALID: The tool isn't fully set up: fill every required parameter from a real source (up to 20 parameters, no file parameters).
err.TOOL_SIDE_EFFECT: A tool with side effects can only be used when the stage has “Real action” on.
err.sideEffectLocked: A tool with side effects needs “Real action”, which this stage can't turn on: every stage in the previous step must have a reviewer.
err.ref: This tool isn't enabled for your company or no longer exists.

if.title: If (true/false branch)
if.hint: Stands alone in its step and runs instantly. If the condition holds it jumps to the True step, otherwise to the False step (empty = next step). Skipped steps show as “Skipped”.
if.noSources: No result field in an earlier step or input to compare yet.

err.IF_INVALID: The If condition is invalid: check the source, comparison, value and target step (must come after this step).

branch.title: Branch
branch.hint: The first matching rule wins. If none match, the run goes to the next step. Skipped stages show as “Skipped”.
branch.locked: Only a stage that is alone in its step can branch.
branch.noFields: Declare structured fields under Output first.

err.field: Rule {{n}}: choose a field of this stage.
err.op: Rule {{n}}: this comparison only works for Number or Date fields.
err.value: Rule {{n}}: enter a value of the field's type.
err.goto: Rule {{n}}: pick a target step that comes after this stage.
err.real: The target step has a Real action stage, so this stage must be reviewed (After the stage = Reviewed by a group).
err.BRANCH_INVALID: A branch rule isn't valid: check the field, comparison, value and target step.

stage.remindHint: Leave empty = one reminder after 24 hours. Up to 10 reminders.
stage.escalateHint: This group is added to the review; the original group can still review. It escalates once and never marks Pass by itself.
stage.excludeStarter: The person who started the run can't review this step

err.escalateGroup: Pick a group other than the reviewing group.
err.ESCALATE_INVALID: The escalation isn't valid: pick a group other than the reviewing group and a time from 4 to 2,160 hours.

set.title: Set values (set)
set.hint: Writes result fields from the run inputs or constants. No AI call.
set.err: Invalid assignment: the field must be declared in Result, the input must exist with the same type.

editor.limitsText: Up to 7 days · 5 runs at once · at most 3 reworks per stage · reviewer reminder after 1 day. Hitting a limit → “Needs a decision”.
editor.readonly: This is a template (read-only). Copy it to edit.

sources.title: Process sources
sources.empty: This process uses no sources yet.
sources.max: A process can have at most 20 sources.
sources.gone: This source no longer exists. Remove it before saving.
sources.inUse: Source {{key}} is used by stage {{n}}. Remove it from the stage first.

stageSources.title: Stage sources
stageSources.allowlistHint: One pattern per line (e.g. docs/**/*.md). Empty = the whole source; the 50 MB / 2,000 file limit still applies.
stageSources.none: Add sources to the process in the “Process sources” card first.
stageSources.notInDef: Stage {{n}} uses a source that is not in the process source list.
stageSources.autoOutput: This stage will require a “## Nguồn tham chiếu” section in its output (added automatically).
stageSources.budget: Default budget is 200,000 tokens if the stage sets none.

inputs.title: Process inputs
inputs.note: If a required field is missing, the agent will ask the person running the process.
inputs.label: Display label

mustKnow.label: Must know before starting
mustKnow.hint: One item per line. The agent asks about what it does not know yet (at most 3 questions per stage).

glob.invalid: Invalid path pattern: no “..”, no leading “/”, at most 256 characters.

input.key: The field key must be 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
input.keyDup: This field key is already used.
input.label: Enter a display label (at most 80 characters).
input.options: A Choice field needs 1–20 options, each at most 200 characters, with no duplicates.

mustKnow.tooLong: Each item can be at most 200 characters.

err.ttl: From 1 to 365 days, or choose No expiry.
err.TEAM_SECTION_UNOWNED: A required section has no team member in charge. Edit the team's sections or remove it from the output.

editor.ttlHint: A run not finished within this many days expires. Runs already in progress aren't affected when you edit.
editor.limitsTextTtl: Up to {{days}} days · 5 runs at once · ≤ 3 reworks per stage · reviewer reminded after 1 day. Hitting a limit → “Needs a decision”.
editor.limitsTextNoTtl: No expiry · 5 runs at once · ≤ 3 reworks per stage · reviewer reminded after 1 day. Hitting a limit → “Needs a decision”.
editor.limitsWait: Runs waiting for a date don't count toward the 5 concurrent runs.

decision.title: The process stopped at stage {{stage}}
decision.waiting: Waiting for someone allowed to decide

cancel.title: Cancel this run?
cancel.body: The run stops for good; existing outputs stay viewable.

apiError.PROCESS_NOT_FOUND: Process not found or you can't run it.
apiError.TOO_MANY_PROCESS_RUNS: Your company is running the maximum of {{max}} processes. Try again later.
apiError.PROCESS_DEF_INCOMPLETE: Pick a reviewing group for every reviewed stage before enabling.
apiError.PROCESS_REF_INVALID: This agent/team/group is disabled or gone.
apiError.TEMPLATE_READ_ONLY: Only platform admins edit templates. Copy the template instead.
apiError.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: This process uses a code source this tenant doesn't have. Create the source first (Sources page), then save again.
apiError.PROCESS_DEF_INVALID: The process isn't valid. Check the fields marked with errors.
apiError.NOT_PROCESS_DECIDER: You aren't allowed to decide this run.
apiError.NO_OUTPUT: There is no output version to use yet.
apiError.PROCESS_IN_USE: The process is the default or assigned to tenants: it cannot be deleted, turned off or re-keyed.
apiError.PROCESS_NOT_PUBLISHED: The process is not published. Publish it first.
apiError.PROCESS_PUBLISH_INVALID: The process is not valid to publish. See what is wrong below.
apiError.SLOT_SHAPE_UNSUPPORTED: This slot only accepts sequential steps (no parallel, no branches). Fix it in Canvas.
apiError.SLOT_GROUPS_MISSING: Some tenant lacks a department code the process uses. See the missing codes below.
apiError.SLOT_BODY_INVALID: The Form content is not valid. See what is wrong below.
apiError.SLOT_UNKNOWN: The process slot does not exist (is the app turned off?).

validate.sectionRequired: At least one required section is needed.
validate.fieldKey: Field key: lowercase, digits, underscores, starting with a letter.
validate.realAction: A real action needs the previous stage to have a reviewer.
validate.stageKey: Stage key: 1–32 characters, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.
validate.executor: Pick an agent or an agent team.

canvas.title: Process canvas
canvas.empty: No stages yet. Add the first stage.
canvas.loadFailed: Couldn't load the canvas. Showing the list view instead.
canvas.readOnly: Sample process: view only, drag and drop is off.

confirmRemove.title: Remove stage “{{name}}”?
confirmRemove.body: Any “go back” choices pointing to this step will be dropped.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.move: Alt + ←/→: move to previous/next step · Alt + ↑/↓: reorder within the step
shortcuts.open: Enter: open details · Delete: remove stage

live.rejected: Couldn't move: step {{step}} already has 3 stages

err.step: Invalid step numbers. Drag the stage into a valid column.
err.realStep: Real action needs every stage in the previous step to have a reviewer.
err.backTarget: You can only go back to steps before this stage.

autofix.title: Autofix
autofix.hint: The agent edits files in a copy of the source and produces a diff for a person to review. Nothing is pushed.

install.label: Install command
install.ph: e.g. bun install (leave empty = no install)

allow.label: Editable paths
allow.hint: Up to 20 patterns. .github/workflows is blocked unless listed explicitly.

autofix.net: The container that runs the agent and tests has no network. The install command runs first, with network, for up to 600 seconds. With no install command there is no network at all.

err.test: Enter a test command (up to 1000 characters).
err.install: The install command can be at most 1000 characters.
err.allow: Up to 20 patterns, each a valid glob.
err.AUTOFIX_EXECUTOR: An autofix stage must be run by an agent.
err.AUTOFIX_REVIEW: An autofix stage always needs a person to review it. Choose "Review" under After stage.
err.AUTOFIX_MAX: A process can have only one autofix stage. It is already set on stage "{{stage}}".
err.sourceKind: Source "{{key}}" is of kind {{kind}} and cannot be edited. Choose a git_remote or local_path source.

apply.title: Apply the fix
apply.hint: Pushes a branch and opens a PR with the fix the reviewer just approved. Runs as a program, with no agent. The apply mode comes from the source of the autofix stage.
apply.note: The pushed branch is named ai/<run>/<stage>. The default branch is never pushed to directly.

err.APPLY_NO_AUTOFIX: The apply stage must come right after the autofix stage.
err.APPLY_MAX: A process can have only one apply stage. It is already set on stage "{{stage}}".
err.APPLY_REAL: The apply stage must have "Real action" on.
err.APPLY_AFTER: The apply stage must continue when done, with no review step.
err.APPLY_FIELDS: The apply stage has no sources, autofix, token budget or must-know.

showcase.title: Sample flow: Expense approval
showcase.subtitle: Parallel → join → if/else branch. Try it now, no AI needed.
showcase.missing: The sample flow is not in this company yet. Ask an admin to run the sample-flow seed (demo tenant only).

swap.title: Swap node
swap.hint: The "canSwap" check is now applied: the editor lets you swap a node across families, unless later steps use this node's fields.

can.field_ref: Loses a field later steps use.

review.rejectNote: Rejected from the sample flow page

inUse.default: Default process of the slot: cannot be deleted or turned off. Change the default first.
inUse.assigned: Tenants are using it: unassign first.

system.hint: System node of the slot: cannot be deleted or changed
system.locked: System node of the contracts app: locked, cannot be deleted or changed.

publish.title: Publish “{{name}}”
publish.body: Only the published version runs. New runs of tenants using it follow this version; running ones keep the old one.
publish.impactFail: Could not load the impact. Try again.
publish.runs: {{n}} runs in progress (keep the old version).
publish.defaultNote: It is the default: applies to every unassigned tenant from the next approval run.

releases.title: Release history of “{{name}}”
releases.body: Rolling back to an old version creates a new version with that content.
releases.confirmBody: Creates a new version with the content of v{{n}}, applied to the next approval run. Running ones keep the old version.
releases.done: Rolled back to v{{from}} (new version v{{to}})

assign.title: Assign “{{name}}” to tenants
assign.body: {{slot}}: one process per tenant, a new assignment replaces the old one. Unchecking = back to the default process.

preview.title: Preview the path of “{{name}}”
preview.body: Enter a contract type and a sample value: which steps run and which are skipped. Nothing is written.

default.title: Set “{{name}}” as the default?
default.body: {{slot}}: unassigned tenants will run this process from the next approval run. Assigned tenants do not change.

form.lead: Sequential approval steps. Step 1 is fixed; e-sign is always last. Departments are written by code (e.g. pb-ke-toan), resolved per tenant.
form.name: Step name
form.excludeStarter: The person who submitted may not approve this step
form.firstNoCond: The first step always runs, no condition.
form.unsupported: This process has a shape the Form cannot show (e.g. parallel steps). View only; edit it in Canvas.
form.difyCanvas: Dify steps are kept as they are in Form; edit them in Canvas.

esign.signerDept: Department code of the signing head
esign.info: After approval it is sent for signing automatically; once signed the flow ends.

err.GROUP_REQUIRED: Enter the department code of the step.
err.DUE_RANGE: Deadline is outside the allowed range.
err.REMIND_RANGE: Reminder is outside the allowed range ({{min}}–{{max}} hours).
err.ESCALATE_SAME_GROUP: Escalation cannot be the same department as the step.
err.FIRST_CONDITIONAL: The first step has no condition.
err.whenEmpty: The condition is empty: pick a contract type or a value.
err.amountInvalid: The amount must be a non-negative whole number.
err.FIRST_NOT_REVIEW: The first step must be an approval step.
err.ESIGN_NOT_LAST: E-sign must be the last step.
err.SIGNER_GROUP_REQUIRED: Enter the department code of the signing head.
err.difyEmpty: The Dify step has no workflow.
err.AFTER_DIFY_CONDITIONAL: The step after Dify has no condition.
